meta.purpose: Track income, expenses, savings — and how they map to deadlines and points
meta.axiom: Points = money SENT to the fund. Track what goes in, not what you have.

current_state.savings_note: This is NOT points. Points = 0 until money is transferred to the fund.

varanasi.note: ₹8K-14K/mo — food, transport, misc (if not at BHU yet)

tourist_visa_run.note: Every 6 months — exit and re-enter. Flight + border fees.

income.note: Add income sources here. Remote work, freelancing, etc. Each £500 earned = 1 point when saved.

burn_rate.note: Cambodia is cheap. This drops to £100-170/mo in Varanasi (BHU hostel covers accommodation).

savings_plan.method: Every £ saved beyond expenses goes to the fund. Fund = points.

runway.note: At current burn rate, savings last 7.7 months. Need income by Mar 2027.
runway.critical_date: Mar 2027 — need income stream established before BHU application
runway.if_no_income: Burn through £5,000 by ~Apr 2027. Then dependent on BHU scholarship/loan.
runway.if_income_1000mo: Savings grow to £15,000 by Jul 2027. Comfortable.
runway.if_income_500mo: Savings grow to £10,000 by Jul 2027. Tight but workable.

points_timeline.description: How savings translate to points over time

no_income.verdict: CANNOT afford BHU. Must leave India or find income.

500_month.verdict: Can afford BHU. Tight but workable. £13K saved.

1000_month.verdict: Comfortable. £18.5K saved. BHU + estate scouting trips possible.

points_timeline.key_metric: Monthly income > Monthly expenses + £160 (BHU savings rate)

what_you_need_to_track: Fund balance (what's been committed to the vision)
Runway (months until money runs out at current burn)
Deadline proximity (how close to each payment deadline)
